tool: Built-in GPT Image (latest exposed; model version not returned)
method: Per-frame native 8x pose + MICA concept + approved S2 sign anchor; new drawing; fixed-box Lanczos; shared indexed palette; native piece mask and inside ink.

ending-00.png.prompt: Create ONE isolated pixel-art sprite, not a sheet. Input 1 is ONLY the exact native pose/framing reference. Input 2 defines MICA, an ORIGINAL female pangolin: rounded overlapping jade scales, small round ears, cream tapered muzzle/belly, expressive dark eyes/lashes, white gloves, coral hiking boots with jade laces, tapered scale tail. Input 3 is approved MICA pixel-art style. Redraw reference pose completely as MICA, new drawing, never a recolour. Match head direction, facial expression, hands, gesture, limb positions, perspective and proportions to reference. No Sonic features, quills, hedgehog ears, Sega characters, text or furniture. Bold clean pixel clusters and 1 native-pixel dark outline; designed for 32x40 native pixels. This frame is s1 ending-00, standing slightly three-quarter right, hands held together near waist, quiet attentive expression. Keep entire body and tail within reference framing. Transparent background, no shadow, no extra margin. Output same aspect ratio as first reference.
